text: P84 MiCOM 5th Generation | GE Vernova | Electrification

The P84, part of the MiCOM P40 Agile 5th Generation family, is a multi-functional line terminal Protection that delivers high performance processing and a graphical HMI as standard. It is ideal for HV, EHV and UHV applications on lines and cables for 1 or 2 breaker applications with patented adaptive auto-reclose functionality.

text: Transmission and distribution systems are essential for the safe, sure routing of power from generation sources to consumers. However, exposed overhead lines transporting power are by nature sometimes vulnerable and prone to fault. In the case of a faulty circuit, the MiCOM range provides speedy protection to trip and isolate it, thereby preventing further damage. Each relay model contains a complete suite of backup protection elements covering all current, voltage and frequency applications. This permits simplified application and spares holdings, because the relay can be adopted as the standard protection platform.
heading: Overview

text: The MiCOM P84 is suitable for feeders controlled by a single circuit breaker and for complex installations where feeders are controlled by two circuit breakers such as ring bus/mesh corner formations and the breaker-and-a-half configurations.
heading: Overview

text: Extremely versatile, e.g. managing leader-follower reclosing schemes in the event of dual breaker application

text: S1 Agile is the truly universal PC tool for MiCOM Agile relay, assemble all tools in a palette for simple entry, with intuitive navigation via fewer mouse-clicks. No-longer are separate tools required for redundant Ethernet configuration, phasor measurement unit commissioning, busbar scheme operational dashboards, programmable curve profiles or automatic disturbance record extraction – applications are embedded. MiCOM S1 Agile supports all existing MiCOM, K-Series and Modulex, including a utility for automatic conversion of setting files from previous generations of numerical relays like K-series and MiCOM P20 to the latest P40 Agile models.

heading: Refurbishment Solutions

text: Form, fit and functional compatibility – the P84 fits in the same panel or rack space and offers the same features and Protection performance.
heading: MiCOM P841A/B Relay Replacement:

text: The same S1 Agile software supports the new MiCOM relay and the legacy P841A/B
heading: MiCOM P841A/B Relay Replacement:

text: Take the order code (CORTEC) of the older relay being removed, typically a blue case relay
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Translate to today’s latest GE Vernova MiCOM model, adding Ethernet options if required
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Extract settings and logic, use S1 Agile toolsuite to convert settings
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Detach the terminal blocks from old relay, leaving wiring attached / detach terminal blocks from the new.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Carefully examine the terminal blocks to see that no physical damage has occurred since installation.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Mount new relay. Old relay blocks fit straight onto the new relay - safer, less wiring to reconnect.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: It is recommended to apply rated current and voltage to the relay CT/VT inputs during secondary injection testing to check the continuity of the CT/VT terminal block connections to the relay.
heading: Pin-Pin Upgrade Methodology:

text: Test, return circuit to service with only minutes of downtime
